title: Update service coverage copy and remove a live photo

requirements.text: Update the Service Coverage banner user-facing copy to include this exact sentence in visible on-page text (English, matching punctuation and capitalization): "Service coverage areas in Ahmedabad and Gandhi Nagar - Professional residential cleaning services including flats, bungalows, offices, and hospitals". Use this sentence as the Service Coverage banner caption text (below the banner image) so visitors can read it without relying on image alt text.

quotes: Service coverage areas in Ahmedabad and Gandhi Nagar - Professional residential cleaning services including flats, bungalows, offices, and hospitals

acceptanceCriteria: In `frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts`, the English locale string `serviceCoverage.caption` is set to exactly: "Service coverage areas in Ahmedabad and Gandhi Nagar - Professional residential cleaning services including flats, bungalows, offices, and hospitals".
`frontend/src/components/landing/ServiceCoverageBanner.tsx` continues to render the caption from `t.serviceCoverage.caption` below the banner image, and the new sentence is visible on the page.
No CTA destinations or section order/layout are changed as part of this copy update.

requirements.text: Delete one photo from the Live Photos section by removing the last photo entry currently defined in the `livePhotos` array in `frontend/src/components/landing/LivePhotos.tsx` (the item whose `src` is `/assets/generated/live-ac-water-jet-1.dim_1600x1200.jpg`).
acceptanceCriteria: `frontend/src/components/landing/LivePhotos.tsx` no longer includes the photo object with `src: '/assets/generated/live-ac-water-jet-1.dim_1600x1200.jpg'` in the `livePhotos` array.
The Live Photos grid renders with one fewer photo card than before.
There are no remaining references to `/assets/generated/live-ac-water-jet-1.dim_1600x1200.jpg` in frontend code (so the deleted photo is not rendered anywhere).

constraints: Keep all existing CTA destinations unchanged (including tel:+918000262644, https://wa.me/918000262644, Instagram link, and Google Business Profile link).
Do not change page section order or remove any sections other than the single requested Live Photos item removal.
Frontend immutable paths must not be edited (as defined in SYSTEM_CONTEXT).
nonGoals: Do not add new service areas or modify the existing Ahmedabad/Gandhinagar area lists as part of this change.
Do not add new images or replace existing image assets beyond removing the one Live Photos entry.
Do not change SEO metadata or structured data as part of this change.
